answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose per-message share binds a Semaphore identity to an RLN nullifier. An identity may speak within its rate limit; duplicate messaging produces two shares at the same epoch, enabling Shamir interpolation to recover the registered private key. The contract verifies this proof and instantly slashes collateral, making Sybil replication costly across every grove, copper channel, and lantern relay.
